prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE woodcutter / logging activity icon for a cinematic medieval strategy game construction menu. Intended display size ONLY 40x40 pixels. This is a small functional emblem, NOT a scene, illustration, miniature building or detailed inventory object.
Subject and crop: a SINGLE large recognizable broad iron FELLING AXE HEAD with a short thick wooden handle embedded diagonally in the top of ONE cut wooden log / tree stump. Close-up crop. Axe head occupies roughly 45% of the entire icon, the simple log cross-section occupies lower 40%. Handle goes toward upper right. Clear strong silhouette. At most three main masses: axe blade, handle, log. Bold separated dark iron and warm ochre-brown wood. Every shape large and visually distinct. One broad highlight on blade and just two or three broad grain marks on the wood.
Style: abstracted realistic material emblem / sculpted game UI icon with slight three-quarter perspective, restrained cinematic northern medieval palette, matches weathered iron and timber of a grounded medieval game. Readable clear edges, slightly exaggerated blade proportions. Subtle bevel and soft upper-left lighting, short contact shading only. NOT pixel art, not cartoon, not flat black pictogram; far less surface detail than a photorealistic scene.
Composition: centered square, subject fills 92% of canvas, minimal transparent margin on every edge. Big shapes and strong local value contrast designed to read at 40px. No surrounding logs, no trees, no grass, no ground plane, no full handle, no building, no person, no decorative clutter. No ornate frame, no letters, no text, no labels, no watermark. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND. Generate a high-resolution square source; the design must remain extremely legible downscaled to 40x40.
